company.name: Courtyard
company.shortDescription: Courtyard is an online marketplace for trading cards & digital packs
company.description: Courtyard is a platform that provides liquidity to collectible assets via physically backed NFTs. It allows ownership of physical collectibles to be instantly and securely transferred anywhere in the world via NFTs, without the physical item itself having to be moved. Connected Collectibles - a new, frictionless way of storing and trading physical goods - is redefining physical asset ownership.

productsAndServices.description: An online marketplace for buying and selling graded basketball, baseball, football, and Pokémon trading cards linked to digital collectibles.

productsAndServices.description: Digital packs that users open online to reveal associated physical trading cards, including sports and Pokémon collectibles.

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables holders of eligible digital collectibles to redeem the corresponding physical trading cards for delivery worldwide.
productsAndServices.name: Physical Card Redemption

productsAndServices.description: A storage service for keeping physical trading cards in a vaulted and insured environment while they remain available through the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Vaulted and Insured Card Storage

productsAndServices.description: A collection submission service for presenting trading-card collections to Courtyard for potential inclusion or handling through its platform.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $30,000,000, or 72.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,316,582 to $192,896,765, a 58.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
